sections.label: Head
sections.text:
Dull, pressing frontal pain, especially con-
nected with constipation. M3^algic pain in scalp and
muscles of neck. [Cimicif.^ Eczema on forehead along
line of hair. Sinusitus, after coryza.

sections.label: Ears
sections.text:
Roaring. Muco-purulent discharge. Deaf-
ness. Eustachian catarrh, with high-pitched voice.

sections.label: Nose
sections.text:
Thick, tenacious secretion from posterior
nares to throat. Watery, excoriating discharge. Ozrena,
with ulceration of septum.

sections.label: Mouth
sections.text:
Peppery taste. Tongue white, swollen, large,
flabby, slimy; shozvs imprint of teeth [Merc.]; as if
scalded : stomatitis.

sections.label: Throat
sections.text:
Follicular pharyngitis. Raw, smarting, ex-
coriating sensation. Hawking of yellow, tenacious mu-
cus. [Kali bicli,] Child is aroused suddenly from
sleep by this tenacious post-nasal dropping. Goitre of
puberty and pregnancy.

sections.label: Stomach
sections.text:
Sore feeling in stomach more or less con-
stant. Weak digestion. Bitter taste. Pain as from a
hard-coniered substance. Gone feeling. Pulsation in
epigastrium. Cannot eat bread or vegetables. Atonic
dyspepsia. Ulcers and cancer. Gastritis.

sections.label: Abdomen
sections.text:
Gastro-duodenal catarrh. Liver torpid,
tender. Jaundice. Gallstones. Dull dragging in right
jp!Oin with cutting sensation into right testicle.

sections.label: Back
sections.text:
Dull, heavy, dragging pain and stiffness, par-
ticularly across lumbar region, must use arms in raising
himself from seat.

Rectum- — Prolapsed ; anus fissured. Constipation,
with sinking feeling in stomach, and dull headache.
During stool, smarting pain in rectum. After stool,
long-lasting pain. [Nit. ac.] Hiemorrhoids ; even a
light flow exhausts. Contraction and spasm.

sections.label: Urine
sections.text: Gleety discharge. Urine smells decomposed.

sections.label: Male
sections.text:
Gonorrheea, second stage ; discharge thick and
yellow.

sections.label: Female
sections.text:
Erosion and excoriation of cei vix. Leucor-
rhoca. Averse after menses {Bov.; Calc, c.]; acrid and
corroding, shreddy, tenacious. Menorrhagia. Pruritus
vulwe, with profuse leucorrhoea. [Calc, c.; Kreos.;
Sep.] Sexual excitement. Tumor of breast; nipple
retracted.

sections.label: Respiratory
sections.text:
Chest raw, sore, burning. Dry, harsh
cough. Bronchial catarrh, later stages. Bronchitis in
old, exhausted persons, zidth thick, ycllozv, tenacious
expectoration. Frequent fainty spells, with cold sweat
all over.

sections.label: Skin
sections.text:
Eruption like variola. Lupus ; ulcers, cancer-
ous formations. General tendency to profuse perspira-
tion and unhealthy skin. [Hepar.]

g. Throat. — Dryness and burning heat of the throat — Stinging dry-

15* Male Sexual Organs. — Increase of sexual desire, lascivious;

90. Neck and Back.— Tettery spots on the nape of the neck.— Pains

as. Upper Limtw.— Trembling of the arms and of the hands, e^. in

slightest effort to swallow liquid.— Spasms and convulsions (with watery

ci gnawing at the pit of the stomach, eyes prominent, cries» grinding of the
